question: As per newest notification of december 2023, the decennial Census of India to be delayed till at least ____________ .
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tue Oct 01 2024 00:00:00 GMT+0530 (India Standard Time)**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Tue Oct 01 2024 00:00:00 GMT+0530 (India Standard Time)** is the new date announced for the decennial Census of India as per the newest notification of December 2023.
 
• The decennial Census of India is a comprehensive exercise conducted every ten years to gather demographic data on the population of the country.
 
• The delay in the Census is attributed to various administrative and logistical challenges faced during its planning and execution phases.
 
• The Census provides critical data that informs government policies, plans, and the allocation of resources across different sectors.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The Census of India** has been conducted since 1872 and is one of the largest administrative exercises in the world.
 
• It is conducted by the Office of the Registrar General and Census Commissioner, India, under the Ministry of Home Affairs.
 
• The data collected during the Census includes information on population size, distribution, socio-economic characteristics, housing, and amenities.
 
• The Census data is crucial for policy-making, planning, and administration at the national, state, and local levels.
 
• Due to its scale and importance, the Census operation involves extensive planning, training, and coordination among various government agencies and stakeholders.
